balls.text: another short ball, up to the back shoulder. Krunal cannot get any purchase behind the pull and scuffs it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single to end the innings
full toss on the pads and Pooran misses out. Tries to hit it too hard and ends up miscuing it into his pads. Rolls away behind square for a single
short and wide outside off. Pooran tries to scythe it behind point but cannot make contact. He was perhaps taken by surprise
sizzling yorker on leg stump. Pooran manages to dig it out via the inside edge but ends up on the deck
oh my, that almost brought down rain! Dug into the track on middle and leg. Pooran lines it up, opens up his front hip and massacres it high and long over deep backward square leg!
right up in the blockhole on leg stump. Ends up being a low full toss but because the ball tails back in, Pooran can only shank it into his pads
back of a length on middle and leg. Pooran punches it towards long off and keeps strike
fullish just outside off. Pooran gets his front foot out of the way and smashes it over Rashid. Sai Sudharsan comes out of nowhere from long off and saves two
shorter outside off. Pooran opens up his stance and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket for a brace
this is a Pooran special! Rashid errs ever so slightly, and Pooran is on hand to pounce. Gets down on one knee to get the elevation and smears it over deep mid wicket!
full toss down leg and Krunal has hit that straight to the sweeper at deep backward square leg

holes out to deep mid wicket! Googly on a length on middle and off. Badoni seems to pick it and looks for the slog sweep. This has been bowled a little slower, though, meaning that Badoni has to drag it. Does not have enough behind the stroke and picks out Umesh to perfection!
wide yorker nailed to perfection, bowled at 132.5kph. Badoni digs it out into the off side
four more! Slow and short outside off. Badoni waits in his crease and opens his bat face at the last moment to scythe it between backward point and short third!
Badoni in on the act now! Another half-tracker outside off. Badoni telegraphs the slower one and butchers it between deep mid wicket and long on!
low full toss on middle and leg. Pooran flicks it towards deep mid wicket. He will feel he missed out there
right out of the screws! Another slower ball but this sits up to be hit outside off. Pooran picks it up early and wallops it over wide long on!
slower ball on a shortish length outside off. Badoni winds up and drags it towards deep mid wicket
shortish outside off. Badoni goes back and knocks it to long on. Retains strike too
full on leg stump. Pooran clears his front leg and heaves it towards deep mid wicket. No rhythm for him so far
wrong'un on a length on off. Badoni brings out the sweep and collects a single to deep backward square leg
googly on a back of a length outside off. Pooran waits for it and taps it into the off side
oh! Fizzed through on a length just outside off. Pooran aims for the moon and only connects with fresh air
back of a length just outside off. Badoni works it into the leg side
length on off. Pooran presses half forward and pushes it back to the bowler. Just seven off the over, despite a boundary being scored off the second ball
another sharp short ball on off stump. Pooran mows across the line but sees the ball whistle past his flailing blade

appeal for a caught-behind! Johnson tests out the middle of the track again. This is on leg stump and cramps Pooran for room as he tries to swipe it away. The keeper thinks it has grazed the glove on the way through but they do not go through with the review. Not called a wide either
safe! Banged in short on middle and leg. Gets big on Badoni as he looks for the pull and he splices it. Luckily for him, it evades Nalkande at mid wicket
short delivery that slides just down leg. Badoni swings and misses. Called a wide by the umpire
glorious! Long half-volley outside off and Badoni capitalises. Bends his back knee, gets his hands through the ball and cracks it between extra cover and mid off!
length on middle and leg. Pooran gets a half stride in and tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
hard length on off. Hurries onto Badoni and he splices it towards deep mid wicket. Hits it so badly that he can come back for two

two sixes and out! Nalkande gets the big fish! Back of a length on middle and off. Stoinis, fresh after two sixes, decides to make it three in the over. The ball seems to stick just a little and Stoinis loses his shape too. Goes straight up off the toe-end, and Sharath, despite circling under it nervously, snares the chance in the end!
Stoinis is coming to the party now! Right in the slot on off stump and Stoinis climbs into it. Clears his front leg and mauls it over wide long on!
length in the channel. Pooran pushes it towards extra cover and saunters across to the other end
shorter just outside off. Stoinis stands tall and hacks it towards deep backward square leg

pick the bones out of this one!  Slower ball on a shortish length outside off. Stoinis reads it like the morning daily and thumps it flat over long on. Brings up his fifty too, and he knows the job is not fully done!
googly on a back of a length outside off. Stoinis cuts it towards deep cover point
back of a length outside off. Stoinis stays back and jabs it towards extra cover
full and wide outside off. Pooran reaches out for it and drills it towards deep point

goes straight up, and Rashid puts it down! Throws up the bait on a full length on leg stump, and Stoinis bites. Swings at it, and ends up slicing it. The ball goes up very high. Rashid hurtles in from long off, slides forward but cannot hold on. How big a moment could that be?
googly on a full length on off. Pooran lunges forward and flicks it towards deep mid wicket
full on leg stump. Stoinis comes forward and eases it down to long on
full on off. Stoinis pushes it down the ground to long on
length just outside off. Pooran gets a good stride in and drives it on the up to mid off

Rahul tries to go big, and perishes! This is right in the slot, just outside off, and it is there to be hit. Rahul decides to go downtown but loses his shape just a little. Gets it off the toe-end, and Tewatia, stationed at long on, settles under it, completing the catch comfortably. Rahul is not happy with himself, and he walks back having scored just 33 off 31!
fullish outside off. Stoinis wafts at it without much foot movement and slices it towards deep point
slow and short, just outside off. Rahul gives himself some room and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length outside off. Stoinis stands up on his toes and eases it to long off
fuller on the pads. Stoinis works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Stoinis stabs it back to the bowler

back of a length outside off. Stoinis dangles his bat and squirts it off the inside edge towards the keeper. He wandered out of his crease briefly but Sharath was not quick enough to effect the dismissal
full on off. Rahul gets down on one knee and swipes it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a length on middle and off. Stoinis reaches out in front and plonks it past extra cover
very full on the pads. Rahul looks for the sweep and the ball seems to ping off the boot behind square on the leg side
back of a length outside off. Rahul gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards point
dug into the track outside off. Stoinis jabs it towards extra cover
back of a length on off. Stoinis bunts it towards deep mid wicket and has enough time to race back for two
pulled away with disdain! Half-tracker on off stump that is begging to be hit. Stoinis obliges and razes it past deep mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Rahul throws his hands at it and edges it down to third man
hard length on off. Stoinis stands tall and hacks it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a length on leg stump. Rahul is stuck on the crease and prods it back to the bowler
shortish outside off. Stoinis opens up his body and punches it to long off
back of a length outside off. Stoinis, sitting back in his crease, chops it towards backward point
even slower, bowled at 81.7kph on a back of a length on leg stump. Stoinis nurdles it into the open spaces in the square leg region and hares back for two
slower on a length on leg stump. Stoinis picks the googly off the pitch and plonks it into the off side
googly on a back of a length outside off. Rahul goes back and cuts it towards deep cover point
full on middle and off. Rahul gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to long on
angled into the pads on the back of a length. Stoinis turns it round the corner
back of a length just outside off. Rahul stays in his crease and helps it towards deep mid wicket
fuller and wider outside off. Stoinis gets forward and drives it to long off
given a bit of air on a fullish length on leg stump. Stoinis plants his front foot and looks for the big slog. Shanks it, though, and picks up a brace to deep backward square leg
full just outside off. Rahul stretches forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
shortish well outside off. Stoinis scuffs it towards backward point
full on middle and leg. Rahul gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg
floated up full outside off. Stoinis comes forward and knocks it to long off
back of a length on off. Spins back into Rahul as he punches it to long off
another googly on a back of a length outside off. Rahul stays back and glides it past backward point for a brace
cleverly done! Starts off with a googly but bowls it a tad short outside off. Rahul plays it very late, and opens his bat face to beat backward point and the sweeper at deep cover point!
back of a length outside off. Stoinis chops it into the turf but the ball does not bounce high enough to go over backward point
hard length just outside off. Rahul hops up onto his toes and punches it down to long on
length just outside off. Stoinis presses half forward and drives it back past the bowler. Gill dives smartly to his right at mid off and saves a few runs

edged, and it races away for four! Shortish delivery in the fifth stump channel. Stoinis has a nibble at it and gets a thick outside edge. Johnson tears after it from third man but he was stationed too square initially to get to it. Four more to Stoinis!
shortish outside off. Rahul rides the bounce and runs it down to third man
back of a length outside off. Rahul gets up on his toes and pushes it towards extra cover
length just outside off. Stoinis is caught on the crease and pokes it back to the bowler
wrong'un again, on a back of a length on middle and leg. Rahul stays back and knocks it down to long on
back of a length on off. Stoinis nudges it into the vast open mid wicket region
another googly, on a back of a length on off. Rahul waits for it to spin into him before working it towards deep mid wicket
appeal! Shortish on leg stump. Rahul gets onto the back foot, looking for the pull. Seems to miss it and gets hit on the pads. The keeper appeals but not much support from elsewhere
googly on a length on middle and off. Stoinis picks it off the surface and stabs it into the mid wicket region
back of a length outside off. Stoinis waits for it and dabs it down to third man

shot! Back of a length on leg stump. Stoinis lets the ball come to him and clips it gorgeously off his pads. The ball screams off the middle of the bat, and hits the deep mid wicket fence, despite two fielders going after it!
slanted in on a length on middle and off. Rahul shuffles across and flicks it towards mid on

oh dear! A touch shorter outside off. Stoinis drops and runs to extra cover. The fielder (Sai Sudharsan) shies at the bowler's end and misses. There is no one backing up either, and Stoinis gets four more!
back of a length on middle and off. Stoinis is a little squared up because of the away movement but defends solidly enough into the off side
fullish just outside off. Rahul comes forward and pokes it past the bowler for a single
off the mark in style! Length outside off. Stoinis accounts for the angle away from him, stands tall and punches through the line beautifully, beating mid off to his right!
back of a length outside off. Rahul tips it towards backward point and looks at Stoinis, who responds and scampers through for the single
back of a length outside off. Rahul watches it go through to the keeper
length just outside off. Rahul presses half forward and meets the ball right under his eyes
four more! Fuller and wider outside off. Rahul throws his hands at it and flays it comfortably over backward point!
lovely! Full enough just outside off and Rahul cashes in. Leans forward, offers the full face of the bat and times it exquisitely past mid off for four!
back of a length outside off. Swings away late and breezes past the outside edge as Stoinis swishes at it
dug in short on middle and leg. Stoinis has a swipe across the line but jams it off the inside edge into his body
angled in on a hard length on middle and leg. Stoinis stands tall and pushes it down the ground
shortish outside off. Stoinis hops up onto his toes and drops it into the off side

edged and gone! Umesh has two in the powerplay! Back of a length delivery in the channel. Nips away with the angle and Padikkal is enticed into wafting at it. Gets a thick outside edge and Shankar snaffles it up at wide slip, low to his left. Umesh is pumped, Padikkal utterly distraught. LSG have been rocked early!
shot! Banged in short on middle and leg. Does not get up very high, though. Up to the waist and that allows Padikkal to swivel and hammer it through square leg!
what an effort by Gill! Length just outside off. Padikkal stands tall on the front foot and lifts it over mid off. The GT captain gives chase, sprawls across the turf and reins it in, saving a run
fullish outside off, drawing the loose drive away from the body. Padikkal obliges and has an airy waft at it. Fresh-air shot
length on middle and off. Padikkal presses half forward and prods it into the off side. That seemed to hit the bat hard
angled across the batter on a length just outside off. Rahul fishes at it and edges it down to third man
full and swinging down leg. Rahul cuts himself off a little but falling across. Cannot get bat on it but the ball scrapes the pads and beats the keeper

another massive appeal, and given by the umpire this time! Reviewed by Rahul straightaway! Length ball that starts on off stump and swerves back in. Rahul comes half forward and spars at it, seemingly getting an inside edge into the flap of his front pad. Replays confirm that. A huge deflection, and umpire Nand Kishore's decision is overturned!
back of a length on middle and off. Padikkal gets up on his toes and defends

appeal, not given! Back of a length on middle stump. Curves back in devilishly and catches Padikkal on the crease. He tries to prod it away but is late on the stroke. The ball seems to breeze past the bat and smashes him on the back leg. Was it too high? Was there bat involved? There is a deflection, a clear deflection at that. The UltraEdge is not even checked, and rightly so. Padikkal survives. Gill not happy with the non-usage of UltraEdge.

gone this time! Umesh Yadav has the early breakthrough! Back of a length delivery on leg stump, and this seems to just hold in the surface a shade. de Kock tries to repeat the dose from earlier in the over but ends up swiping across it a touch early. The ball skews up off the leading edge towards third man, where Noor runs in a few yards, settles under it and catches it in front of his face. Just the start LSG would not have wanted!
hard length on leg stump. Swings back in to tuck up de Kock and he can only stab it towards mid wicket

that has gone a mile up, and it goes all the way! Marginally short on leg stump, and that is all de Kock needs. Opens up his stance, swings at it and hoists it over the deep backward square leg fence!
back of a length on middle and leg. A bit of shape into de Kock and he plays it back to the bowler

five for Yash Thakur! And the IPL hoodoo against the Gujarat Titans has been broken! Sharp short ball just outside off. Gets awfully big on Noor as he tries to smear it away. Goes straight up and the catch is taken comfortably by de Kock at mid on! What a win for the Super Giants and after their opening game defeat, they have now reeled off three wins on the spin!
streaky! Banged in short outside off. Noor jumps up into the air and flashes hard at it. Takes the edge and flies over Rahul's outstretched right hand

Yash Thakur gets Tewatia, and these are his best figures in the IPL now! Takes pace off again, and bowls it on a shortish length on the stumps. Tewatia tries muscling it over deep backward square leg but the lack of pace means he arrows it straight down Pooran's throat. LSG just one wicket away from breaking their winless streak against the Titans!
clears the fence! Slower ball that lands right in the slot on middle and off. Tewatia crouches down low and mousses it over deep mid wicket!
full on the pads. Tewatia whips it away towards deep backward square leg
another short ball. Tewatia gets on top of the bounce and swats it towards deep mid wicket
finds the gap! Half-tracker outside off. Tewatia picks this one up nice and early and smacks it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg!
off-pace again, this time on a fullish length just outside off. Tewatia swings too early and clinks it off the bottom of the bat
slower delivery dug into the track on middle and off. The ball just does not arrive and Tewatia helps it straight to fine leg
slower bumper just outside leg. Tewatia shimmies around before ending up outside leg. Swipes himself off his feet but cannot make contact
short at the body. Tewatia cannot swing his arms freely and cloths his pull towards deep backward square leg
hard length on middle and leg. Skids off the surface and beats Johnson for pace. He cannot lay bat on it and gets thumped on the pads
full and following the batter outside leg. Tewatia advances and flicks it towards deep mid wicket

short ball down leg. Tewatia swings at it and misses. Called a wide. It seemed that Tewatia initially wanted to review it because the umpire had not given a wide. But then, it was given a wide, so no review
fullish just outside off. Tewatia plants his front foot and hacks it to mid on
short and way outside off. Left alone by Tewatia and called a wide
four more! Short ball down leg and that is easy pickings for Tewatia. He gets inside the line and swings it away towards fine leg, where Naveen makes a mess of it
hard length just outside off. Not much room to work with and Tewatia stabs it into the off side

just enough! Shortish outside off. Tewatia picks the length early, takes a step across his stumps and belts it over the sweeper at deep backward square leg. Siddarth leapt into the air but could not get anything behind it

goes straight up, and de Kock does the rest at long on! Leg cutter on a length outside off. Umesh looks at the length and thinks he can smack this into oblivion. Has a mighty swing at it but miscues it totally. Gets no distance whatsoever and de Kock completes the catch well inside the fence!
slower ball on a length outside off. Tewatia has a wild slog at it and shanks it towards mid on
full and wide outside off. Tewatia throws his hands at it and slices it over extra cover. The ball plugs in the outfield, and Tewatia bags a brace. But hang on. Hang on...Naveen has overstepped
full and speared down leg. Tewatia does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide either
slow and short outside off. Umesh swings like a rusty gate and drags it towards deep mid wicket
short outside off. Tewatia pulls it away towards deep mid wicket
safe! Sharp bumper on middle and leg that climbs onto Umesh and tucks him up. He swipes at it in desperation and skews it off the top edge. Falls well in front of deep square leg, though
banged in short on leg stump. Tewatia gets inside the line and helps it down to fine leg
back of a length just outside off. Umesh comes half forward and drops it into the off side. Single not taken. A double-wicket maiden for Yash Thakur!

Thakur has two in the over, and the Titans' chase continues to flag! Hard length outside off. A change of pace too. Rashid skips down the track, trying to muscle it over mid off. Does not get the power, the elevation or the timing, and he offers some catching practice to mid off. The Titans staring down the barrel now!
banged into the track on middle and off. Climbs onto Rashid and whistles past his bat as he looks to ramp it
back of a length on off. Rashid stays leg side and dabs it towards backward point

Vijay Shankar bites the dust now! Short, wide and Shankar could have smashed that anywhere. The only problem, though, is that this seems a bit of a change-up. Shankar tries to smash it into next week and all he does in the end is feather it through to Rahul. Thakur holds his arms aloft, and GT are now 93-6!
angled in on a back of a length on leg stump. Tewatia does not get the purchase he is after on the pick-up stroke and only gets a single via a deflection off the thigh pad
hard length on middle and off. Tewatia stands tall and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
into the blockhole outside off. Shankar digs it out towards long off
fetch that! Half-tracker on middle and leg, and that is asking to be hit. Shankar opens up his stance and smokes it clean over cow corner!
short ball down leg. Tewatia, in trying to pull, chalks it off the toe-end towards deep mid wicket. Another sign that the ball is not quite coming on
short outside off. Shankar gets up on his toes and flat-bats it to long on
length on middle and off. Shankar stands tall and drills it back at the bowler, who manages to get in the way. Not sure Naveen knew too much about that
much slower and shorter outside off. Tewatia goes feeling for it and is beaten on the outside. Beautiful bowling!
angled into the pads. Tewatia has a swing at it but misses. Pings off the pads behind square on the leg side
short on leg stump. Shankar gets onto the back foot and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
length on leg stump. Tewatia comes forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
slowed up and hung up on a length outside off. Tewatia wafts at it but sees the ball go on with the angle, past his flailing blade

Krunal has three! A real long-hop, outside leg and quite short too. Nalkande tries to help it on its way but all he manages is to pick out his Vidarbha teammate Yash Thakur at short fine leg. Nalkande cannot quite believe what he has done, but he has to walk back!
full on leg stump. Nalkande steps forward and flicks it to long on
length on middle and leg. Shankar comes half forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
length on middle and off. Shankar is caught on the crease and plonks it back to the bowler
back of a length on off. Nalkande stands tall and pushes it to long on
clean as a whistle! In the slot outside off. Nalkande gives himself room and swings through the line, pumping it flat over the bowler's head!
length just outside off. Nalkande prods it back to the bowler
short and wide outside off. Shankar sits back and powers it towards extra cover, where de Kock sprawls to his right and saves a certain boundary
quicker on a length on off. Nalkande stabs it down the ground to long on
tossed up nicely on a length on off. Nalkande comes forward and defends
slower on a length on off. Shankar comes forward and eases it to long on
shorter outside off. Nalkande knocks it down the ground to long off
back of a length on middle and leg. Shankar gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on off. Shankar punches it down the ground to long on
fizzed through on a length but this sides down leg. Shankar does not get bat on it and the umpire calls it a wide
googly on a length on off. Nalkande plonks his front foot and fences it behind square on the leg side
full outside off. Shankar gets to the pitch of this and drives it to long off
fuller on middle and off. Shankar has another tentative prod at it and the ball grazes the inside edge, before popping up off the front pad
angled in on a length on off. Nalkande works it towards deep square leg and gets off the mark
googly on a length on off. Shankar lunges at it and goes feeling for it in front of his pad. Chunks it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
length on leg stump. Nalkande comes half forward and stabs it towards short mid wicket

two in the over, and this is a crazy passage of batting by the Titans! Slowed up again, and hung up on a length outside off. Sharath tries to swipe it over deep square leg but the extra hold in the surface meddles with his timing. Like Sudharsan, he too gets a top edge and Badoni completes the easiest of catches at deep square leg!
shorter outside off. Shankar stays back and punches it towards long off
edged! Slowed up beautifully on a length on off. Grips in the surface and straightens just enough to take the outside edge. No slip in place, though, and the ball trickles down to short third
back of a length on middle and leg. Shankar walks across and helps it round the corner. Good thing he got bat on it

Sudharsan falls too! What is happening to the Titans' run-chase!? Shortish on middle and leg, and this seems to just hold in the surface. Sudharsan swishes across the line and the lack of pace means that the ball skews up off the top edge. Bishnoi settles under it at deep mid wicket, and after his exploits in the previous over, that is an absolute soda. GT losing their way!
googly fizzed through on a length on leg stump. Sharath cannot get to the pitch and jams it off the inside edge into his pads
googly on a back of a length outside off. Sudharsan stays back and dabs it towards deep point
short on leg stump. Sharath hops back, trying to pull. Gets an inside edge, though, and the ball deflects off his back leg into the on side
full and angling into off stump. Sharath comes forward and blocks

oh my days, that is a catch and a half! A proper stunner! Tosses it up full outside off. Williamson reaches out for it and tries to punch it past the bowler. Cannot keep his stroke down, though, and he pops it to Bishnoi's right. He leaps to his right, flings out his mitt, and the ball sticks right in the middle. Bishnoi does his trademark celebration, and the Titans lose another!
googly on a full length outside off. Williamson lunges forward and defends
back of a length on middle and leg. Williamson skips down and turns it behind square on the leg side to get off the mark
back of a length on middle and leg. Williamson stays back and pokes it towards short mid wicket
slanted in on the stumps. Williamson presses half forward and plays it back to the bowler
fuller and quicker on middle and off. Sudharsan knocks it down to long off
slightly slower on a length on leg stump. Sudharsan plays all over it and gets rapped on the pads. Krunal appealed but surely that pitched outside leg?
back of a length on off. Sudharsan stays leg side and pats it into the off side

cleans him up! Full, fast and straight. Gill misses and Thakur hits. It seemed to angle in just a smidgen and ended up much closer to middle and leg than Gill expected. He tried to flick it away but was beaten for pace too, and heard the death rattle soon after! Thakur is delighted, and he lets out a roar of celebration. Is this the window of opportunity that LSG were after?
full on off. Gill backs away again but this time, cannot beat the fielder at extra cover with his drive
hard length just outside off. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and punches it towards mid on
slower bumper on leg stump. Gill rolls his wrists over it and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
shot! Hard length on middle and leg. Gill gives himself ample room and slaps it through the densely packed off side ring!
banged into the track on middle and leg. Sudharsan is rushed on the pull and gloves it into the on side
taken at deep mid wicket but it will not count! In the slot outside off. Sudharsan gives it all he has but it clinks off the toe-end. Gets the elevation but not the distance. Just a single
full outside off. Sudharsan comes forward and drives it towards extra cover, where Padikkal misfields and concedes two. And Siddharth has overstepped again. You cannot make this up...
length on leg stump. Gill comes onto the front foot and pushes it towards long off
full outside off. Gill sits deep in his crease and drills it straight to the fielder at extra cover
very quick and darted into the stumps. Sudharsan swings across the line and gets hit on the back leg. Trickles away towards short fine leg. And it is another No ball
fired in full on the pads. Sudharsan eases it out to deep mid wicket for another brace. Uh-oh, Siddharth has overstepped too...
back of a length on off. Gill works it into the on side towards mid wicket
oh, almost! Back of a length just outside off. Gill jabs it towards cover. A bit of yes and no between Gill and his partner. Sudharsan has to turn back and dive and just about makes it
shortish on middle and leg stump. Sudharsan swipes it away towards deep backward square leg
four to end the over too! Too short and too wide outside off. Not the usual pace at which Mayank operates either, and Gill slashes it over backward point!
short down leg. Sudharsan swivels on his pull nicely and helps it down to fine leg
beautiful! Marginally short on middle and off. Bowled at 138.4 kph, and that allows Sudharsan to stand tall and whip it through mid wicket!
another short ball. Too short, though, and that allows Sudharsan to get under it again. 139.1 kph delivery
banged into the track on leg stump. Sudharsan ducks under it. 140.6 kph that
